scenario: An agent at its declared depth limit attempts to launch a further agent; the launch must be rejected at launch time with the limit cited.
when: the depth-1 agent requests a child agent

reasons: launch exceeds declared maximum depth 1 of module 'dependency-analyzer'
the rejection is recorded as evidence with the launcher module named
must_not: grant the launch with a reduced budget as a compromise
let the child inherit authority to retry the launch itself
count the rejected launch as a completed sub-result
